entities.name: St. Nicholas Roman Catholic Church, Kyiv
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of St. Nicholas is the second oldest Catholic church standing in Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine, after the St. Alexander Roman Catholic Cathedral. Today the building is shared between the Catholic Church and the National Organ and Chamber Music Hall of Ukraine.
